Select every available app. Essential system apps are excluded. Enable and resume the lock service to apply protection.
All apps will be deselected. You can select individual apps again.
Settings, home screen and dialer stay available for device management and emergencies.

Accessibility is used to identify the app you open and display its lock screen. We do not read screen text or messages, or record keystrokes. No internet permission or advertising services.\n\nYou can disable the service in Android settings at any time. After agreeing, choose FirstCode Lock and enable the service.
On • Deactivate device admin before uninstalling
Off • Add a confirmation step before uninstalling
Enter your PIN to disable removal protection

Android will ask you to activate device admin. It must be deactivated before uninstalling. This adds a step, not permanent prevention; the owner can deactivate it in Android settings. We do not request device wiping or changing its screen lock.
This feature is not supported on this device

All unlock sessions end when the screen turns off or the service restarts.
Enter your current PIN before changing it
Selected apps will not ask for a PIN until you enable the service again.
No ads or tracking. Works offline and keeps settings on your device.

Use your phone screen lock too. The service and device admin can be disabled in Android settings. An app may appear briefly before locking; notifications and recent-app previews are not hidden.\n\nIf the service stops, review battery and accessibility settings. Grant permissions only after understanding their purpose.
Incorrect PIN. Five failed attempts require a 30-second wait.
Verify with biometrics enrolled on your device
Biometric verification failed. Use your PIN.
After deactivating protection, you can uninstall FirstCode Lock. Uninstalling will stop app protection.
Adds a device admin deactivation step before uninstalling. You can deactivate it in Android settings at any time.
